messages:
Mia: Drafting the Redwood Optimize launch post — aiming to publish Wed 3/25 by 10am PT. Draft is in Google: https://go.redwood/optimize-draft. Need quick review on messaging + data. TL;DR: highlight cost/perf wins, customer story, and checklist for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Oliver: Quick read — two headline options:
1) "Reduce inference cost by 3x with Redwood Optimize"
2) "How Redwood Optimize cuts per-token cost while keeping latency"
I lean toward #2, less clickbaity.
Sam: FYI press embargo 3/25 10am PT. I'll own distribution. Need a 2-3 sentence "what's new" and top 3 metrics. Confirm spokespeople: Maya + Jude? :eyes: 
Judy: Can we avoid absolute '3x' until we publish methodology. Suggest "up to 3x" plus link to benchmark appendix. Also add a short note on model compatibility (quantized vs fp16).
Leo: Raw numbers from staging traces (summary): median cost reduction 2.8x; mean 2.4x; 95th latency delta +12ms in quantized mode. I'll paste table here:
```
model | workload | cost_reduction | p95_latency_delta
redwood-13b-quant | conv-chat | 2.8x | +12ms
orca-7b-q4 | batch-gen | 3.1x | +8ms
```
Ash: Hero art vA and vB uploaded: https://fig.redwood/design/optimize-hero. vA is more product-y, vB more customer-story focused. Need final headline to choose.
Maya: I'm comfortable with "up to 3x" + methodology link. Also want a short customer quote. Who can help pull one? :speech_balloon: 
Jude: Happy to pull a quote from beta partner (Acme AI). I'll DM Acme PM. Also thumbs on spokespeople.
Mia: Action items: (1) finalize headline copy (Oliver), (2) confirm metrics wording (Leo + Judy), (3) pick hero (Ash), (4) PR one-pager (Sam), (5) customer quote (Jude). Please add approvals in the doc by 6pm PT. :+1: 
Sam: Drafted distribution plan: targeted list (VentureBeat, The Information, TechCrunch (infra), Signeo ML), embargo email ready. Schedule: embargo lift 10am PT, social at 10:05, blog post syndicated to Medium at 11:00. Will share CSV.
Oliver: Two final headline variants for voting in doc. Vote with :one: or :two: in the doc comments.
Press-bot: Reminder — scheduled tweet slot 10:05am PT reserved. :robot_face: 
Ash: Quick note on assets — can we include two screenshots (dashboard + cost graph) and a 30s clip? I can produce the clip by tomorrow noon.
Mia: Great. If no major objections, we'll push to publish 3/25 10am PT. Minor edits via doc comments only. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
